metadata.description: Delegate Claude Code tasks to any installed headless CLI coding agent (one-shot Bash, no app-server).

plugins.name: cli-agents
plugins.description: Universal headless-CLI delegation plugin for Claude Code. Ships the cli-delegate subagent (cli-headless + delegation-result skills), slash commands (/cli-agents:setup, delegate, review, status, result, cancel, models), one-shot Bash job control, an opt-in Stop review gate, JSON schemas, and prompt templates.
